description:
• About Our Brand and Products:

SENdyno is more than a clothing brand — we’re a movement built to raise awareness, spark conversations, and celebrate neurodiversity.

Founded as a home education project by a father and son, SENdyno combines creativity, inclusion, and purpose into bold, meaningful apparel. Our designs support the Special Educational Needs (SEN) community and are created for children, parents, educators, and advocates who want to wear their message with pride.

We create high-quality, comfortable clothing with powerful statements that resonate — from autism awareness and non-verbal advocacy to homeschooling pride and neurodiversity empowerment.

Every design tells a story. Every purchase spreads awareness.

• What Makes Us Different:

  • We are a family-founded, purpose-led brand.

  • Our designs are bold, conversation-starting, and emotionally relatable.

  • We focus on positivity — empowering rather than pitying.

  • We represent real lived experience within the SEN and home education communities.

  • Our mission goes beyond profit — we aim to support SEN causes as we grow.

We’re not just selling T-shirts.
We’re building a community.

• How Affiliates Can Earn:

As a SENdyno affiliate, you’ll earn commission on every sale generated through your unique referral link.

  • Competitive commission rates

  • Trackable links and discount codes

  • Easy-to-use dashboard via UpPromote

  • No upfront costs

  • Performance-based rewards as you grow

The more you share, the more you earn — simple as that.

• How to Promote Us:

Promoting SENdyno is easy because our message connects.

You can:

  • Share your unique link on social media (TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest)

  • Create content wearing our apparel

  • Post authentic stories about neurodiversity and inclusion

  • Add your link to your bio

  • Share with relevant Facebook groups or communities

  • Write blog posts or email newsletters

  • Use your custom discount code to encourage conversions

Authenticity wins. The more personal and genuine your message, the better your results.

• Other Information:

We’re especially excited to partner with:

  • SEN parents

  • Neurodivergent creators

  • Homeschool families

  • Educators

  • Inclusion advocates

  • Micro-influencers with engaged communities

No huge following required — engaged and aligned audiences matter more than numbers.

If you believe in spreading awareness, celebrating differences, and building something meaningful… we’d love to have you on board.

Let’s grow together 💛
